heroIntro: Welcome, I am David Billington. I am available online, and face to face in Horndean, Hampshire. I provide a safe place where you can confidentially share your life, your story and what may be painful and confusing for you. Together we can share your burden and find a new way of being. You can make incredible changes and empower yourself to take the right path for you.
aboutText: I am a registered member of the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP) and follow its ethical framework. Alongside my private practice, I work for I’m All Ears counselling service in Surrey. I offer a confidential space to explore what is happening in your life and what you would like to change.
supportTitle: Counselling for ADHD, anxiety and more
supportIntro: I work with adults facing a range of experiences, including:
approachText: Everyone experiences challenges, and sometimes we need support to navigate them. Counselling gives us time to explore and understand your thoughts, feelings and behaviours together. Sessions are available face to face in Horndean, online or by phone. We can work at a pace that suits you and review what is helpful as we go.
introTitle: A first conversation, with no pressure
introText: Choosing a counsellor can feel like a big step. I offer a free 20-minute phone call so you can ask questions, tell me what you're looking for and see whether working together feels right.
availability: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, including evenings
contactText: You may know exactly what you need, or you may just want to talk it through. Send me a short message and I'll get back to you.
location: Horndean, Hampshire · online across the UK
